title: Transferring morphism record
description: Morphism: a Heyting algebra A with the extension-image sub-algebras { image(H(i_{s,t})) } of its independent one-step extensions -> the nuclear dyad (A, delta). The forward-facing transfer nucleus reflects onto Fix(delta) = intersection of the extension images: delta(a) = meet { b in Fix(delta) | b >= a }, the smallest extension-witnessed element above a (delta = id when there are no independent extensions). Provably a nucleus.

extension-images.description: Each entry is the carrier (subset of A) of one independent one-step extension's restriction image -- a sub-Heyting-algebra of A. Their intersection is Fix(delta).
